literal: Town having become confused sorrow it will suffer, mind having become confused evening comes spreading time.
translation: When evening comes spreading and confuses the mind, this whole town becomes bewildered and suffers sorrow.
modern: அறிவு மயங்கும்படி மாலைக்காலம் பரவி வரும்போது, இந்த ஊரும் மயக்கமடைந்து துன்பத்தை அனுபவிக்கும்.
explanation: The heroine observes the overwhelming effect of the evening on her surroundings. The word 'மதி' (mind) refers to how the arrival of dusk disorients the intellect and stirs up deep emotional distress. Projecting her own inner turmoil onto the world around her, she feels that as the evening spreads ('மாலை படர்தரும் போழ்து'), the entire town ('பதி') shares in her bewilderment and suffers the same sorrow ('பைதல் உழக்கும்').
